scope: Reconcile the released ACadSharp baseline, the open ACIS DXF writer PR, and its ACDS schema prerequisite; refine existing optional peer-comparison readiness without asserting a local defect or promoting 3D support.

method.kind: Primary project release, issue, and pull-request state review
method.reportingBoundary: The ACDS unit-test failure is a contributor comment about the open #1174 branch; it was not independently reproduced and is not attributed to ACadSharp master, released v3.8.0, or PR #1240.
method.evidenceRule: A release, issue report, open PR, or peer self-test does not establish local libdxfrw behavior, current deployed capability, cross-version carrier preservation, B-rep validity, or native application acceptance.

evidence.observed: The release page identifies v3.8.0 at signed commit 3a1c66b and lists InternalsVisibleTo as the release change. It does not announce ACIS DXF-writer support.
doesNotEstablish: that a later release has not appeared after this research snapshot
that mutable master behaves identically to the v3.8.0 package
runtime behavior on any ACIS DXF/DWG witness
evidence.planUse: Use v3.8.0 as the released comparison baseline only after verifying that it is still the desired pin when a composed peer run is scheduled.

evidence.topic: ACIS DXF writer issue and candidate PR
evidence.observed: Issue #1195 describes omitted 3DSOLID/REGION content on ACadSharp 3.4.9, including blocks that become empty. The maintainer says the entities are not yet supported by the DXF writer. Linked PR #1240 is open, has no review/deployment shown, and depends on #1174. Its description mentions ACIS serialization, version checks, warnings for unsupported binary payloads, and pre-2013 compatibility.
doesNotEstablish: that PR #1240 builds or passes its prerequisite tests
complete R2013+ SAB/ACDSDATA output or block/INSERT closure
native CAD acceptance or B-rep semantic correctness
evidence.planUse: Treat #1240 only as an experimental candidate; distinguish its exact source/build and emitted-version profile from released behavior.

evidence.observed: PR #1174 remains open and describes ACDS schema/storage refactoring and embedded-record parsing. An August 12 contributor comment says a focused owner-attachment test failed on that PR branch because readAcdsRecord threw NotImplementedException, with the post-2013 DXF path losing the payload. This report was not rerun here.
doesNotEstablish: the exact state of PR #1240's dependency checkout
that the owner-attachment failure persists in a later revision
evidence.planUse: Make exact dependency resolution plus a focused ACDS owner-attachment read test the first readiness gate before spending time evaluating #1240.

evidence.observed: FreeCAD's documented stock DXF path does not construct proprietary ACIS solids. ezdxf documents raw ACIS access and limited faceted projections rather than a general B-rep kernel.
doesNotEstablish: any current FreeCAD or ezdxf runtime result for the local generated controls
that carrier-byte preservation implies valid geometry
any relationship between these tools and the ACadSharp writer branch
evidence.planUse: Keep record identity, payload transport, ACDS ownership, B-rep validity, and downstream consumer acceptance as independent evidence stages.

optionalPeerGateOrder: Recheck current release/tag and pin the released package separately from the PR build.
Pin PR #1240 head/base SHAs, dependency commits, toolchain/target framework, and artifact hash.
Resolve #1174 at the exact dependency revision and run the focused ACDS owner-attachment test first.
If ready, test pre-2013 inline SAT separately from R2013+ SAB/ACDSDATA using existing locally authored controls.
Include a solid-only block and INSERT closure; compare source owner/handle, emitted entity, diagnostics, payload digest/length, ACDS linkage, and strict readback.
Report transport, entity recognition, ACDS association, B-rep semantics, and native acceptance separately.
implementationReadiness.fastValidation: No new per-slice test cadence. Keep the default loop on touched strict builds, focused generated tests, compatibility compile checks where applicable, and diff checks; run the peer only at its existing composed checkpoint.
